market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and XAUUSD are trading in bearish/neutral consolidations below their daily VWAPs inside or near value area lows without volume confirmation. BTCUSD is holding above VAH but faces CVD divergence near resistance. US100 exhibits the cleanest bullish trend structure above VWAP and EMA20, pushing Session Highs.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.95 to VAH 4059.52) and trading below POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.36) with a negative slope (-0.81). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price recently rejected the S/R level at 4052.38 and is drifting lower, but remains trapped mid-range within the value area without volume expansion. Recommendation is HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11614) and below POC 1.11374. CVD is NEUTRAL (-679) despite a positive short-term slope (+2143.48). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (1.11506) and EMA50 (1.11519), hugging the lower ATR band (1.11321). RVOL is low at 0.57 without recent volume spikes. Price is hovering right above the Session Low (1.11307) and VAL; holding mid-structure near key support without volume confirmation favors patience. Action is HOLD.

Price is trading below VAL (1.33186) and well below POC 1.33473. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,068) with positive short-term slope (+827.99). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33303) and EMA50 (1.33327), hugging the lower ATR band (1.33085). RVOL is low at 0.523. Price has broken below Prev Low (1.33119) and VAL, testing Session Low (1.3307). However, lack of yellow RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation makes this breakdown prone to a sweep trap into support. Action is HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28047.89 to VAH 28298.66) and above POC 28118.76. CVD is BULLISH (+9.09) with slight negative slope (-0.47). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading solidly above VWAP (28099.54) and EMA50 (28109.18), touching the upper ATR band (28296.81). Dukascopy US100 tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0 (rvol_last 0.942), but persistent upward structure above EMA20 (28215.20) signals strong trend continuation pushing against Session High (28298.66). Buying live pullback near 28296.43.

Price is above VAH (73848.10) and POC 73660.40. CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) showing slight divergence against price. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73678.23) and EMA50 (73740.71), consolidating near the upper ATR band (74219.79). RVOL is moderate at 1.098 with no yellow volume spikes. Price is testing S/R resistance at 73975.3 just below Session High (74085.20). With divergent CVD and lack of volume expansion on BTC, breakout momentum is unconfirmed. Action is HOLD.
